title: uuencoding-multi: add tests for bare-marker-only subjects, looks_like_filename path branch, truncated-body reassembly
description: Three test gaps: (1) bare 'Part 1 of 3' with no surrounding text should return None from parse_subject; (2) looks_like_filename path-separator branch (s.contains('/')) has no test; (3) reassemble with all parts present but one UU body truncated should produce is_truncated=true with missing_parts.is_empty().
